decisions.reason: The ceiling or floor pipe bracket sits close to the core pipeline fabrication business, costs little to keep on offer, and fits the firm's plan to broaden its range, so the option is still worth holding.
The pipe support bracket uses existing steel fabrication and coating capacity at minimal carrying cost and complements the core infrastructure offer, so there is no reason to abandon it.

The powder-coated public waste bin is far from the core business, and with no observations since 2019 its prospects are still unresolved; because it reuses the firm's coating capability and keeping it is cheap, the option is held open for now.

The waste bin with ashtray is a multi-model line distant from the core, which raises its carrying cost, but municipal customers overlap with existing utility customers, so it is kept while demand evidence accumulates.

The outdoor public ashtray line diversifies into street furniture using the coating and welding equipment the firm already has; its value is still uncertain rather than disproven, so the option stays open, with a higher risk of being pruned.
